_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Niger covering Saharan rock art, Aïr Mountains civilization, trans-Saharan trade, Hausa states, Songhai influence, Kanem-Bornu, French colonisation, uranium mining, coups, and jihadist insurgency.

910.name: Prehistoric Niger and Saharan Rock Art
910.description: Green Sahara period; Ténéré pastoral communities; Dabous giraffe petroglyphs; Aïr Mountains settlement.

sub_clusters.name: Green Sahara and Early Pastoralism
sub_clusters.description: Saharan pluvial supports cattle herding, fishing, and hunting; Gobero cemetery reveals diverse populations.

sub_clusters.name: Dabous Giraffe Petroglyphs and Rock Art
sub_clusters.description: Life-size giraffe carvings at Dabous; Aïr and Ténéré rock art documents vanished ecosystems.

sub_clusters.name: Aïr Mountains Early Metallurgy
sub_clusters.description: Copper smelting in the Aïr Mountains among the earliest in West Africa; Agadez region settlement.

920.name: Trans-Saharan Trade and Early States
920.description: Kanem-Bornu influence in eastern Niger; Songhai reach in the west; Agadez as Tuareg-Hausa crossroads.

sub_clusters.name: Kanem-Bornu Influence in Eastern Niger
sub_clusters.description: Kanuri rulers extend influence over Manga and Lake Chad basin; Islam spreads through trade.

sub_clusters.name: Agadez Sultanate Origins
sub_clusters.description: Tuareg pastoralists dominate Aïr; Agadez emerges as caravan crossroads; Sultanate formalised by 1449.

930.name: Hausa States of Southern Niger
930.description: Hausa city-states including Daura, Gobir, and Maradi; trans-Saharan commerce; Bayajidda legend.

sub_clusters.name: Hausa Bakwai (Seven States) in Niger
sub_clusters.description: Daura, Gobir, and Katsina (shared with Nigeria) develop as walled city-states; cotton textiles and leather.

sub_clusters.name: Gobir and Resistance to Fulani Jihad
sub_clusters.description: Gobir kingdom is epicentre of Hausa-Fulani tensions; Usman dan Fodio launches jihad from here.

930.name: Songhai and Post-Songhai Period in Niger
930.description: Western Niger under Songhai Empire; post-Tondibi fragmentation; Djerma/Zarma successor polities.

sub_clusters.name: Songhai Empire in Western Niger
sub_clusters.description: Niger River valley under Songhai administration; Niamey region integrated into imperial system.

sub_clusters.name: Djerma and Zarma Polities
sub_clusters.description: Post-Songhai Djerma warrior states in southwestern Niger; resistance to Fulani and later French expansion.

940.name: French Colonisation of Niger
940.description: Voulet-Chanoine mission; brutal conquest; Military Territory of Niger; colonial neglect as 'dead-end' colony.

sub_clusters.name: Voulet-Chanoine Expedition
sub_clusters.description: Notorious French military expedition massacres civilians crossing Niger; officers killed by own troops.

sub_clusters.name: Kaocen Revolt (Tuareg Uprising)
sub_clusters.description: Ag Mohammed Wau Teguidda Kaocen leads Tuareg revolt in Aïr against French; suppressed with great violence.

sub_clusters.name: Niger as AOF Territory
sub_clusters.description: Minimal investment; forced labour; groundnut cash crop; uranium deposits unknown until 1950s.

950.name: Independence and Hamani Diori Era
950.description: Independence 1960; Diori's PPN single-party rule; uranium boom; devastating Sahel drought.

sub_clusters.name: Independence of Niger
sub_clusters.description: Niger independent 3 August 1960; Hamani Diori first president; close ties with France.

sub_clusters.name: Uranium Discovery and Mining
sub_clusters.description: Uranium deposits at Arlit; SOMAIR/COMINAK mines; France's nuclear fuel dependency; environmental and health impacts.

sub_clusters.name: Sahel Drought and Famine
sub_clusters.description: Devastating Sahel drought kills livestock and displaces pastoralists; government response inadequate; Diori overthrown.

950.name: Military Rule and Democratic Transitions
950.description: Kountché military rule; Saibou transition; fragile democracy; Baré coup.

sub_clusters.name: Seyni Kountché Military Rule
sub_clusters.description: Kountché overthrows Diori; uranium revenues fund development; authoritarian but relatively stable.

sub_clusters.name: Tuareg Rebellion of the 1990s
sub_clusters.description: Tuareg and Toubou armed rebellion in northern Niger; peace accords 1995; 'Flame of Peace' ceremony.

960.name: Contemporary Niger
960.description: Democratic periods under Tandja and Issoufou; coups; jihadist insurgency in the Sahel and Lake Chad Basin; 2023 coup.

sub_clusters.name: Tandja and Issoufou Presidencies
sub_clusters.description: Mamadou Tandja ousted after unconstitutional third-term bid 2010; Mahamadou Issoufou's two terms; democratic progress.

sub_clusters.name: Jihadist Insurgency (Sahel and Lake Chad)
sub_clusters.description: Boko Haram in Diffa region; ISGS and JNIM in Tillabéri and Tahoua; French and US bases; devastating attacks.

sub_clusters.name: 2023 Military Coup
sub_clusters.description: Presidential Guard General Tchiani overthrows elected President Bazoum July 2023; ECOWAS standoff; French troops expelled; pivot toward Russia.

sub_clusters.name: Uranium Geopolitics and Resource Nationalism
sub_clusters.description: Renegotiation of uranium contracts with France; Chinese and other investors; HALEU fuel demand; resource sovereignty debates.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
